verdict.rationale: The Drive API v3 has a dedicated changes resource ("A change to a file or shared drive"), which is a delta feed of what changed rather than a full re-crawl of files.list. Push notifications that fire whenever a watched resource changes complement it. The cursor mechanism itself is only implied, not shown. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the page-token/start-token cursor semantics, details on retention or expiry of the change feed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of incremental sync working in practice.
